title: Viromics pipeline parameters
description: Amplicon-based viral whole-genome sequencing and genomic epidemiology pipeline.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

run_id.description: Deterministic run identifier recorded in report provenance (defaults to viromics_<sessionId>).

platform.description: Sequencing platform chemistry ('illumina' paired-end or 'ont' single-end long reads).

reads.description: Glob pattern matching input FastQ files (alternative to --sample_sheet).

sample_sheet.description: Path to CSV samplesheet with columns sample_id,platform,fastq_1[,fastq_2].

reference.description: Path to reference genome FASTA file (supports single or multi-FASTA panels).

gff.description: Optional path to GFF3 annotation file for CDS amino-acid consequence translation.

primer_bed.description: Optional path to 6-column primer scheme BED file for strand-aware clipping and callable-target QC.

amplicons_bed.description: Optional path to explicit amplicon insert coordinates BED file.

metadata.description: Optional path to CSV file binding epidemiological sample metadata by sample_id.

cds_models.description: Path to curated CDS ribosomal-slippage/translation exception models JSON.

outdir.description: Output directory where pipeline results and viromics_run_report.json will be saved.

read_qc_options.title: Read QC options
read_qc_options.description: Read trimming and filtering parameters for Illumina fastp and ONT fastplong.

ont_min_mean_qual.description: Minimum mean read Phred quality for ONT fastplong filtering (--mean_qual).

ont_min_length.description: Minimum ONT read length retained after trimming (fastplong --length_required).

ont_max_length.description: Maximum ONT read length retained (0 = unlimited; fastplong --length_limit).

ont_trim_adapters.description: Enable de novo fastplong ONT adapter auto-detection (disabled via -A by default to protect conserved amplicon ends).

ont_adapter_fasta.description: Optional FASTA file of custom ONT adapter sequences passed to fastplong (-a).

ont_adapter.description: Optional single literal ONT adapter sequence for fastplong trimming.

alignment_primer_options.title: Alignment & primer trimming options
alignment_primer_options.description: Read alignment quality and amplicon primer clipping parameters.

min_map_qual.description: Minimum mapping quality (MAPQ) enforced across alignment filtering, depth masking, and variant calling.

min_base_qual.description: Minimum Phred base quality for depth masking and variant calling (auto-default: 20 Illumina, 15 ONT).

min_qual.description: Deprecated alias for --min_base_qual (honored when explicitly set).

primer_tolerance.description: Tolerance window in bp for samtools ampliconclip --tolerance (auto-default: 5 Illumina, 15 ONT).

min_clipped_len.description: Minimum read length retained after QC and primer clipping (auto-default: 30 Illumina, 50 ONT).

variant_consensus_options.title: Variant calling & consensus options
variant_consensus_options.description: Variant calling thresholds, pileup depth normalization, and haploid/IUPAC consensus gating.

ont_mpileup_config.description: bcftools mpileup -X profile for ONT reads (e.g. 'ont-sup', 'ont', or 'none').

min_coverage.description: Minimum high-quality depth (FORMAT/DP) for variant calling and breadth calculations (auto-default: 10 Illumina, 50 ONT).

min_freq.description: Minimum per-allele variant frequency (FORMAT/AD / FORMAT/DP) to report variants (auto-default: 0.2 Illumina, 0.5 ONT).

min_variant_qual.description: Minimum phred-scaled variant quality (VCF QUAL column).

disable_baq.description: Pass -B (--no-BAQ) to bcftools mpileup to prevent depth loss on divergent viral genomes.

max_mpileup_depth.description: Maximum per-sample pileup depth cap; triggers deterministic strand-balanced downsampling when exceeded.

downsample_seed.description: Fixed RNG seed for deterministic strand-balanced BAM downsampling.

min_consensus_depth.description: Minimum HQ depth required to call a consensus base; lower positions are masked as 'N' (defaults to --min_coverage).

min_consensus_freq.description: Minimum allele frequency required for inclusion in haploid consensus (and major indels in IUPAC mode).

use_iupac.description: Emit IUPAC ambiguity codes for biallelic SNPs within [min_iupac_freq, max_iupac_freq).

min_iupac_freq.description: Lower allele frequency bound (inclusive) for biallelic SNP IUPAC ambiguity calling.

max_iupac_freq.description: Upper allele frequency bound (exclusive) for biallelic SNP IUPAC ambiguity calling.

qc_tier_options.title: Sample QC tier options
qc_tier_options.description: Thresholds for PASS/WARN/FAIL classification evaluated on callable target (or whole contig when no BED is given).

qc_pass_depth.description: Minimum callable mean depth required for PASS status.

qc_pass_breadth.description: Minimum callable breadth (%) at min_coverage required for PASS status.

qc_pass_max_n.description: Maximum internal consensus N rate (%) permitted for PASS status.

qc_warn_depth.description: Minimum callable mean depth required for WARN status (below fails).

qc_warn_breadth.description: Minimum callable breadth (%) at min_coverage required for WARN status (below fails).

qc_warn_max_n.description: Maximum internal consensus N rate (%) permitted for WARN status (above fails).

resource_container_options.title: Container & resource options
resource_container_options.description: Container image override and maximum per-task resource ceilings.

container_image.description: Container image tag or Singularity .sif path used by -profile docker / -profile singularity.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested by any single process.

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested by any single process (e.g. '32.GB').

max_time.description: Maximum wall-clock duration that can be requested by any single process (e.g. '24.h').

help.description: Display pipeline usage help message and exit.
